questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}f_x'(0,0)&=\lim_{\Delta x\rightarrow 0}\frac{f(\Delta x,0)-f(0,0)}{\Delta x}=\lim_{\Delta x\rightarrow 0}\Delta x\sin\frac{1}{\Delta x^2}=0\text{，同理，}f_y'(0,0)=0\text{。}\\ \text{当}\ x^2+y^2\neq 0\text{时，有。}\\ \frac{\partial f}{\partial x}&=2x\sin\frac{1}{x^2+y^2}-\frac{2x}{x^2+y^2}\cos\frac{1}{x^2+y^2}\text{，}\ \frac{\partial f}{\partial y}=2y\sin\frac{1}{x^2+y^2}-\frac{2y}{x^2+y^2}\cos\frac{1}{x^2+y^2}\text{。}\\ \text{考虑点}P(x,y)\text{沿直线}y=x\text{趋于}(0,0)\text{时，则有。}\\ \lim_{\substack{x\rightarrow 0\\ y=x}}\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}&=\lim_{\substack{x\rightarrow 0\\ y=x}}2x\sin\frac{1}{2x^2}-\frac{1}{x}\cos\frac{1}{2x^2}=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}2x\sin\frac{1}{2x^2}-\frac{1}{x}\cos\frac{1}{2x^2}\text{，不存在，故}\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\text{在}(0,0)\text{处不连续，}\\ \text{同理}\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\text{在}(0,0)\text{点也不连续。}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \displaystyle \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}-x\cdot 2x}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)^{2}} = \frac{y^{2}+z^{2}-x^{2}}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)^{2}}\ , \\ \\ \displaystyle \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = x\cdot (-\frac{2y}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)^{2}}) = \frac{-2xy}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)^{2}}\ , \\ \\ \displaystyle \frac{\partial u}{\partial z} = x\cdot (-\frac{2z}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)^{2}}) = \frac{-2xz}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)^{2}}\ , \end{array}
